name: WASheet: Bulk Message Sender & WhatsApp CRM
description:
WASheet: Bulk Message Sender & WhatsApp CRM – Your Ultimate WhatsApp Marketing & CRM Solution

Transform your WhatsApp communication with WASheet, the all-in-one Microsoft Edge extension designed to streamline your messaging, CRM, and workflow automation. Whether you're running marketing campaigns, managing customer relationships, or automating business replies, WASheet empowers you to do it all efficiently and professionally.

Key Features:

Message Broadcaster
Send personalized bulk messages effortlessly using Excel, Google Sheets, or any sheet platform. Customize your messages with templates, media, and variables to create impactful campaigns for promotions, announcements, or customer engagement.

WA to G-Sheet
Save your WhatsApp order or product data directly to Google Sheets through Google Forms template in real-time with user consent. No data is stored in external databases — everything flows seamlessly into your sheets for easy tracking and analysis.

AI Chat Assistant
Leverage the power of ChatGPT's latest AI modules for real-time suggested replies. Analyze chat tone, mood, and seriousness with spam alerts to better understand your clients and respond effectively.

Workflow Messages
Automate your business replies with workflow messages triggered by specific keywords. Save hours by letting WASheet handle repetitive responses while you focus on growing your business.

Contacts Import - Export + Check
Import/export saved, unsaved, or selective group contacts in a clean, professional format. Use the WA Number Checker to verify which numbers are registered on WhatsApp in bulk, ensuring your messages reach the right audience.

Privacy Features
Protect your privacy with options to hide profile pictures, chat names, recent chats, and messages. Keep your WhatsApp usage discreet and professional, especially in shared environments.

Quick Replies
Save time with pre-defined quick replies that appear in your chat interface. Send responses instantly with a user-friendly template system.

Start a New Chat
Easily initiate chats with unsaved contacts by simply entering their number and clicking Start a New Chat.

Why Choose WASheet?

Efficiency: Automate and streamline your WhatsApp communication, saving time and effort.

Personalization: Craft tailored messages with media and variables for higher engagement.

Privacy: Keep your chats and contacts secure with advanced privacy features.

AI-Powered: Get smart, AI-driven replies and insights to enhance customer interactions.

User-Friendly: Designed for ease of use, whether you're a beginner or a pro.

Perfect For:

Marketing Campaigns: Send bulk promotional messages with ease.

Customer Engagement: Build stronger relationships with personalized communication.

Business Automation: Automate workflows and replies for better productivity.

Data Management: Sync and organize WhatsApp data directly into Google Sheets.

In-Product Purchases

WASheet offers a Free Plan and optional paid subscription plans:

Free Plan: Limited to 100 credits usage.

Basic Plan: $5/month – includes 1,500 credits usage.

Premium Plan: $10/month – unlimited credits usage.

Lifetime Plan: $299 one-time payment – pay once, use forever.

👉 No auto-renewals. No daily caps. Lifetime users pay once and enjoy permanent access.

All transactions are securely processed via Stripe.

Your Privacy Matters:

WASheet is designed with your security and privacy in mind. All features, including message broadcasting, WA to G-Sheet, and contact management, operate locally or with end-to-end encryption. No data is stored on external servers, your conversations, contacts, and API keys remain secure and private. WASheet complies with Microsoft Edge Add-ons policies and uses trusted payment processors like Stripe for secure transactions. Rest assured, your information is never shared with third parties. For more details, visit our Privacy Policy.

Install WASheet on Microsoft Edge today and take your WhatsApp communication to the next level! Whether you're a business owner, marketer, or CRM enthusiast, WASheet is your go-to solution for bulk messaging, automation, and customer management. 🚀
